The main takeaway from our work is that
the design and use of social robots should not be driven by the technological imperative alone, but should be guided by an understanding of the social and cultural implications of the technology.

the design of robots and the formulation of ethical guidelines for their use are not value-free endeavors, and that they require an awareness and a critical stance on the cultural and political biases embedded in the technological imagination.
